info.name: Livestock ERP Farm Feeding API
info.description: Separate Postman collection for Farm Feeding APIs. Covers draft creation, list/detail retrieval, submit for confirmation, confirm stock posting, reject workflow, and over-available-stock validation. Endpoints use /api/v1; read requests require farms.view and write/workflow requests require farms.manage.
